name: Muzeum Sopotu
funding: A City of Sopot cultural institution. The city's operating subsidy was PLN 2.43M of PLN 2.59M revenue in 2023; own sales were the rest.

name: Zofia and Oskar Hansen House
funding: Branch of the Museum of Modern Art in Warsaw, run jointly by the City of Warsaw and the Ministry of Culture. Named supporters: Audi, EY, E.ON Polska, EFC Foundation.

name: Casa das Marinhas
funding: Visits are run by the Município de Esposende's cultural heritage and museums service.

name: African Renaissance Monument
funding: The Senegalese State allocated CFA 300 million to the site, reported in 2020. Mansudae built it by 2010, paid in land, at a cost given as US$27 million.

name: Plečnik House
funding: The Museum and Galleries of Ljubljana, founded by the City of Ljubljana, runs it. In 2024 the city paid 31 of the museum's 60.5 posts, the Ministry of Culture 28.5.

name: Casa Bloc Museum-Apartment
funding: Barcelona's Institut de Cultura, through the Museu del Disseny, and the Generalitat's Institut Català del Sòl commissioned the apartment. Disseny Hub runs visits; the Generalitat owns the building.

name: La Pedrera (Casa Milà)
funding: Fundació Catalunya La Pedrera, the owner, had EUR 46.3M income in 2025; La Pedrera earned EUR 28.5M against EUR 13.3M of costs.

name: MUHBA Bon Pastor
funding: A site of the Barcelona History Museum, run by the Ajuntament de Barcelona. The Bon Pastor Neighbourhood Plan paid for the new space; museum-wide sponsorship was EUR 41,322 in 2024.

name: Casa Broner
funding: Owned by the Ajuntament d'Eivissa, which received it from Gisela Broner, Erwin Broner's widow. The Govern balear part-funded its restoration from 2009, which cost nearly EUR 293,000.

name: Casa Masó
funding: The Fundació Rafael Masó, a public foundation, manages the house. The Ajuntament de Girona budgeted EUR 224,500 of the EUR 253,500 income for 2025.

name: Museo Casa Botines Gaudí
funding: FUNDOS, formed in 2015 from savings bank Caja España-Duero, runs the museum and lists the building as its asset. It spent EUR 1.16M on museum and collections in 2024.

name: Mas Miró
funding: Fundació Mas Miró's 2024 report lists grants from Secretaría de Estado de Turismo (EUR 100k), Diputació de Tarragona (50k), Mont-roig council (20k), Generalitat (3k), Fundació la Caixa (6k, school visits).
